name: REEVES
author: swtdr34mz
summary: A bi-timbral polysynth in the manner of the Sequential Prophet Rev2: two shape-modulated oscillators per voice, sub and noise, sync, a Curtis-style 4-pole / 2-pole low-pass, three DADSR envelopes, four LFOs, eight mod slots, an effect per layer, arp, poly and gated sequencers, unison with chord memory, stack and split, 8 or 16 voices. ECO and HIGH quality. Panel-style touch pages for both layers.
